atlas.controller_mode_hint: GameHelper auto-detects controller mode, so you normally don't need this. Tick it only to FORCE the controller Atlas layout if auto-detect ever fails. Either way the plugin falls back to the other layout when the selected one isn't found. In controller mode the overlay also stays visible while the inventory is open.
atlas.universal_font: Universal font (render map names in any language)
atlas.universal_font_hint: Loads the plugin's bundled DejaVuSans + GNU Unifont into the overlay so any-language map names render without configuring a font in GameHelper. Affects the whole overlay; turning it off restores GameHelper's configured font.
atlas.uncharted_leylines_hint: Hover a sea ship (Uncharted Waters) to highlight its reveal area: the connection graph between the map nodes a logbook used there will uncover, thicker than the normal node connections. The hidden maps are already assigned client-side, so the highlighted cluster is exactly what that ship yields.
atlas.ships_in_fog_hint: Marks the Uncharted Waters ships the game isn't rendering yet (deep fog) with an icon, one per uncharted sea chunk — so upcoming logbook spots are visible before you sail close. Uses icons\UnchartedShip.png when present, else a ring marker. Hovering the icon also triggers the leyline highlight.
atlas.ritual_predict_hint: Only before the first node of the Ritual atlas line (the line to the Crux of Nothingness) is picked: hover an accessible map in line mode to preview (green, under the map names) the exact Rite-mod chain that start WILL roll, including which nodes get a second mod. Once the line is started the preview turns off; use the planner window to follow routes. Predicted labels are in English.
atlas.ritual_planner: Head of the king planner window
atlas.ritual_planner_hint: Opens a window while the atlas is in line-drawing mode listing every path the line could take from every possible start map, with the predicted reward chain for each. Pick desired rewards in the filter dropdown (a path shows if ANY of them is in its chain); tick a path to highlight its route on the atlas and draw a ray to its first map. Closing the window with X also clears this checkbox.
atlas.ritual_weights_hint: Planner routes are sorted by the sum of these weights over the route's predicted rewards, highest first. 0 = neutral; negative pushes a route down the list.
atlas.planner_filter_hint: filter by desired rewards (any match shows the path)…
atlas.map_rating_show_hint: Draws each rated map's rating (0 = normal … 10 = terrible) as a colored pill to the right of the map name: green → yellow → red. Edit ratings in the table below; the filter narrows by map name.
atlas.language_hint: Display language for map-node names (from maps.json 'translates'). Auto follows GameHelper's UI language; pick a specific language to match your game client instead. Changing it re-labels nodes immediately. Map Group names are matched in the selected language.
atlas.shortest_path_hint: Route lines follow the shortest hop-path through the revealed atlas edges (from the nearest accessible node). When off, a straight line is drawn instead.
atlas.arrow_spacing_hint: Gap between the direction arrows drawn along a route (higher = more spread out).
atlas.show_node_index_hint: DEBUG: draws each node's child-index (its number in the atlas-panel child list) as a badge to the left of the map name, so a node referenced by number is easy to locate on-screen.
atlas.hide_available_hint: Hide maps that are accessible/runnable right now. Route/search targets stay visible.
atlas.show_content_icons_hint: Draws each content as its in-game icon (from Plugins\Atlas\icons\<name>.png) above the map name. Content without an icon file falls back to its text name. Icons are suppressed on visible nodes (the game already draws them there) and shown only on hidden ones.
atlas.search_map_hint: You can search multiple maps at once using a comma separator ','
atlas.draw_paths_hint: Master switch for this group: when off, no route is drawn for any of its content, but each entry keeps its own 'route' checkbox unchanged.
atlas.route_entry_hint: Draw a route to the nearest node carrying this content.
atlas.max_hops_hint: Max hops to route through (0 = unlimited). A longer route is suppressed.
atlas.show_connections_hint: Draw the atlas connection graph — a faint line along every edge between adjacent map nodes, beneath the labels and routes.
